glossary.speedControl: Moves that change who moves first: Tailwind, Trick Room or lowering the foe’s Speed.
glossary.fakeOut: A priority move that makes the target flinch on its first turn, so it loses that turn.
glossary.redirection: Follow Me or Rage Powder: draws the foe’s single-target moves away from the partner.
glossary.intimidate: An ability that lowers both foes’ Attack by one stage when the Pokémon comes in.
glossary.intimidateAnswer: Abilities or items that ignore or punish Intimidate, such as Defiant or Clear Body.
glossary.protect: Blocks moves for one turn. Most VGC Pokémon carry it.
glossary.spread: Moves that hit both foes, or everyone, at once, at 75% power each.
glossary.priority: Damaging moves that act before normal moves, whatever the Speed.
glossary.pivot: Moves that hit or act and then switch the user out, such as U-turn or Parting Shot.
glossary.wideGuard: Protects both Pokémon on your side from spread moves for one turn.
glossary.hazards: Moves that damage Pokémon as they switch in.
glossary.hazardRemoval: Moves that clear entry hazards from your side.
glossary.weather: Sets sun, rain, sand or snow.
glossary.terrain: Sets a terrain that powers up or blocks some moves.
